description: Na₃SbSe₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Se atoms. There are three shorter (3.16 Å) and three longer (3.19 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent Se atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are three shorter (2.99 Å) and three longer (3.17 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Se atoms. There are three shorter (2.98 Å) and three longer (3.21 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. Sb is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Se atoms. All Sb-Se bond lengths are 2.58 Å. Se is bonded to six Na and one Sb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SeNa₆Sb pentagonal bipyramids.
